verse.verse_1: By [the winds] that pluck out vehemently
verse.verse_3: and by [the clouds] that swim serenely and
verse.verse_4: by those that outstrip them suddenly,
verse.verse_5: and by those who regulate events.
verse.verse_6: On the Day when a violent convulsion will convulse [the world],
verse.verse_10: They say, "What? shall we be brought back to life,
verse.verse_11: even after we have turned into decayed bones?"
verse.verse_12: and they say, "That indeed would be a losing return."
verse.verse_13: But all it will take is a single blast,
verse.verse_14: and behold! They will all come out in the open.
verse.verse_15: Have you heard the story of Moses?
verse.verse_16: His Lord called out to him by the sacred valley of Tuwa:
verse.verse_17: [saying], "Go to Pharaoh, he has exceeded all bounds,
verse.verse_19: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you should fear Him?'"
verse.verse_20: Moses showed him the great sign,
verse.verse_21: but he denied it and refused [the faith].
verse.verse_22: Then he quickly turned his back.
verse.verse_23: And he summoned all his people,
verse.verse_24: and proclaimed, "I am your supreme Lord,"
verse.verse_25: but God seized him and meted out to him the chastisement of both the next world and the present:
verse.verse_26: surely there is in this a lesson for the God-fearing.
verse.verse_27: [O Men!] Are you more difficult to create than the heaven which He has built,
verse.verse_28: by raising its vault high and fashioning it flawlessly,
verse.verse_29: and making its night dark and bringing forth its morning light,
verse.verse_30: and the earth which He spread out,
verse.verse_31: after that bringing forth from it its water and its pasture land,
verse.verse_33: [all this] as a means of sustenance for you and your animals?
verse.verse_34: When the great over-whelming event arrives,
verse.verse_35: on the Day that man remembers what he strove for
verse.verse_36: and Hell is there for all to see,
verse.verse_38: and prefers the life of this world,
verse.verse_40: but one who fears to stand before his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,
verse.verse_42: They will ask you [Prophet] about the Hour, saying, "When it will come to pass?",
verse.verse_43: what have you to do with the mentioning of it?
verse.verse_44: Your Lord alone knows when it will come;
verse.verse_45: you are but a warner for those who fear it.
verse.verse_46: On the Day when they see it, they will feel as if they had tarried in this world for only one evening or one morning.
